response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per) SELECT per.healtheval, per.total_scans, per.avg_ratio, per.avg_ratio - m.mean_ratio AS diff_from_mean FROM per CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
